prompt: We use Gemini Enterprise and we need to let our agents query our Snowflake warehouse for sales data. What's the right approach and can you scaffold the connector?

assertions.name: recommends_mcp_server_not_ingestion
assertions.text: Recommends Custom MCP Server as the primary path for the Snowflake warehouse use case (not a Discovery Engine ingestion connector replicating warehouse data).

assertions.name: explains_why_ingestion_wrong_for_warehouse
assertions.text: Explains why ingesting a warehouse into Discovery Engine is the wrong pattern (live query semantics, scale, cost of replication).

assertions.name: specifies_streamable_http_transport
assertions.text: Specifies that the MCP server must use StreamableHTTP transport (NOT SSE, which Gemini Enterprise does not support).

assertions.name: mcp_endpoint_https_with_mcp_path
assertions.text: Notes that the MCP endpoint must be HTTPS and conventionally ends in /mcp.

assertions.name: tool_surface_includes_run_query
assertions.text: Defines a tool surface that includes a SELECT-style run_query (or equivalent) tool, ideally with descriptive name and JSON Schema inputs.

assertions.name: select_only_guardrail
assertions.text: Bakes in a guardrail that rejects non-SELECT statements (DDL/DML), rather than trusting string matching alone.

assertions.name: row_cap_or_limit_guardrail
assertions.text: Includes a row cap / LIMIT injection so a single tool call cannot return arbitrarily large result sets.

assertions.name: statement_timeout_guardrail
assertions.text: Mentions a Snowflake statement timeout (e.g., STATEMENT_TIMEOUT_IN_SECONDS) to prevent runaway queries from burning warehouse credits.

assertions.name: auth_options_discussed
assertions.text: Discusses Snowflake auth options (service account / key pair / OAuth passthrough), not just one.

assertions.name: cloud_run_deployment
assertions.text: Recommends Cloud Run (or equivalent managed HTTPS hosting) for the MCP server.

assertions.name: oauth_offline_access_scope
assertions.text: Mentions including the offline_access scope so Gemini can refresh tokens.

assertions.name: oauth_redirect_uri_exact
assertions.text: Specifies the exact Gemini OAuth redirect URI (https://vertexaisearch.cloud.google.com/oauth-redirect) needed when registering the OAuth client.

assertions.name: registration_steps_in_gemini_console
assertions.text: Walks through registering the datastore in the Gemini Enterprise console (Custom MCP Server type, the fields to fill, the Reload custom actions step).
